Test images (both free to use):
- `face.jpg` — the "astronaut" sample image from scikit-image (NASA photo of Eileen Collins,
  public domain), resized to 256x256. A real photo; used for face detection and as a "real" image.
- `ai_sd.jpg` — a Stable Diffusion image from DiffusionDB (poloclub/diffusiondb, CC0 licence),
  resized to 384x384 and saved as JPEG (so it has no AI metadata). Used as an "AI" image.
